claims.claim_ar: تركيب «إِلَهٍ ... إِلَّا» يفيد الحصر والاستغراق في توحيد الألوهية؛ أي أنه لا إله بحق إلا الله وحده.
claims.claim_en: The construction 'إِلَهٍ ... إِلَّا' conveys restriction/exhaustivity in the oneness of divinity — i.e. there is no true god except God alone.
claims.needs_review_reason: The cited source (al-Kashshaf) discusses the construction in the phrase «ما مِنْ إِلهٍ إِلَّا اللَّهُ» rather than the exact wording of this ayah («لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا هُوَ»); the rhetorical reading is likely equivalent but should be corroborated with additional sources discussing this exact ayah.

warnings: Only one provided source chunk (Zamakhshari al-Kashshaf) directly treats the 'إِلَهٍ ... إِلَّا' construction; other chunks do not discuss this ayah.

The source uses a slightly different syntactic frame («ما مِنْ إِلهٍ إِلَّا اللَّهُ») than the ayah's wording («لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا هُوَ»). Verify equivalence across additional rhetoric/tafsir sources before finalizing K-Map entries.
